narr: A cold front slow moved into the region sparking scattered thunderstorms. The very wet airmass in place allowed storms to produce high rain rates while slowly moving which produced flooding.
ev: Heavy rain produced flash flooding that temporarily closed Highway 114.
Stream gages and public reports indicated flooded streets and multiple flooded homes between Moss Bluff, Dequincy, and Gillis.
